task_title: Restore npm run lint on TypeScript 7
task_criteria: npm run lint exits 0 on a clean tree; introducing a deliberate lint violation (unused const) makes it exit non-zero; npm run build still exits 0

items.criterion: npm run lint exits 0 on a clean tree; introducing a deliberate lint violation (unused const) makes it exit non-zero; npm run build still exits 0
items.detail: Two of the three legs hold, the middle one does not. (a) Clean tree: `npm run lint` -> EXIT=0, "3 problems (0 errors, 3 warnings)" (only unused-eslint-disable warnings in src/ralph-loop/controller.ts:5,9 and src/ralph-loop/types.ts:11). (b) `npm run build` -> EXIT=0 (`tsc`, TS 7.0.2). (c) Deliberate unused const: created src/__lint_probe.ts with `export function probeFn(): number { const unusedProbeConst = 42; return 1; }` and ran `npm run lint` -> EXIT=0, the probe file is not even mentioned in the output. Root cause is the config, not the shim: eslint.config.mjs:34 sets "@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars": "off" and eslint.config.mjs:35 sets core "no-unused-vars": "off". The commit message of 9d7b0ce6 concedes this: "the probe literally quoted in the brief (`const __lintProbe = 1;` alone) does NOT trip this config: the config deliberately turns off @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars". Controls proving the gate itself is live and the shim works: same file with `var x` -> `npm run lint` EXIT=1, "2:3 error Unexpected var, use let or const instead no-var"; unused const plus a bare expression statement -> EXIT=1, "3:3 error Expected an assignment or function call and instead saw an expression @typescript-eslint/no-unused-expressions"; and the same unused-const file linted with a temporary config that enables @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars -> EXIT=1, "2:9 error 'unusedProbeConst' is assigned a value but never used @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars". So the TS6 resolution shim (scripts/lint/ts6-resolution.cjs, wired via NODE_OPTIONS in package.json:26) genuinely restores ESLint under TS 7 — without it `npx eslint` exits 2 with "typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0" — but the acceptance test the task names (unused const must fail the gate) is not satisfied. Probe files were removed; `git status --short src/` is clean.
